name: v1.2.0 security fixes: Brain git guards, Codex Brain MCP inventory, quarantine cap, live checks
goal: Fold four security fixes into v1.2.0 before deploy and tag: neither Brain can write a file through git --output (both Python checks and brain-orchestrator-guard.sh); both Python git checks allow git branch only in listing forms; the Codex Brain refuses to start with an MCP server outside its own set, and its tool trim keeps research and ollama only when IronClaude's own source file exists; a worker usage quarantine ends at most 7 days after the limit event.

tasks.name: Brain git guards, both clients (1b, 1c)
tasks.description: Per plan.md Task 1. TDD. Both Python checks (BrainClient._tool_guard_logic Bash branch, codex_brain_client._git_command_allowed) gain import shlex and, after the subcommand check (its cmd.split() derivation unchanged) and before the --amend check, parse args = shlex.split(cmd)[2:] (ValueError, unbalanced quotes -> refused: Claude message 'Unbalanced quotes are not allowed in git commands.', Codex False), so quoted and backslash-escaped forms ("--output=x", --\output=x) are seen as git sees them; on those args: refuse any arg equal to --output or starting with --output= (every subcommand); for git branch, allow only when every arg starts with - and none is in {-d,-D,-m,-M,-c,-C,-f,--delete,--move,--copy,--force} (no args allowed). The set is BrainClient.GIT_BRANCH_CHANGE_FLAGS and codex_brain_client._GIT_BRANCH_CHANGE_FLAGS; a test keeps them equal. The --amend check keeps the substring test and also refuses commit when any parsed arg equals --amend or starts with --amend= (so --am""end is refused); the hook's --amend grep is unchanged. brain-orchestrator-guard.sh splits log|diff|show) out of its combined arm and exits 2 with a BLOCKED reason when a copy of the command with every ", ' and \ deleted (tr -d) matches (^|[[:space:]])--output(=|[[:space:]]|$); its branch arm is unchanged (it still admits git branch --delete x; the Python checks refuse it). Known residuals: separate-value listing flags (--contains X, --sort X) are refused; --set-upstream-to=, --unset-upstream and --edit-description pass, as in the hook. Step 1 probes that git rejects the abbreviation --outp=. Operator decision 2026-03-09: the Brain keeps git add and git commit.
